in_marathi.name: Vedvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lineage of the Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vedvansh is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the words 'Ved' (knowledge) and 'Vansh' (lineage). It signifies the legacy and knowledge passed down through generations, particularly the knowledge and wisdom of the ancient Vedic texts.
